title: Hide file override drawer during series preview
summary: Hides the Queue file-override drawer while the Apply to Series preview modal is open.
reason: The drawer and series preview modal overlapped, making the review step visually crowded and leaving two competing edit/review surfaces on screen.
behavior_before: Opening Apply to Series left the right file-override drawer and its high-z-index backdrop visible behind the preview modal.
behavior_after: Opening Apply to Series hides the drawer and drawer backdrop so the modal is the only active review surface. Cancel/close restores the drawer, while successful apply closes both the modal and drawer.
